Cannot change the loyalty type because the card has transactions
Изменение вида лояльности невозможно, тк. имеются транзакции по карте

Sie müssen die Felder "Treuetyp", "Beschreibung", "ID" und "Typ" ausfüllen
You must fill in fields "Loyalty type", "Description", "ID" and "Type"

Settings.QueryText:
SELECT AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Period AS Period, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder AS Recorder, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.RecordType = VALUE(ВидДвиженияНакопления.Приход) THEN 22 ELSE 23 END AS RecordType, SUM(AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Quantity) AS Amount, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.PointInTime AS PointInTime, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder REFS Document.BonusesPayment THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsPayment, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder REFS Document.BonusesPayment AND ISNULL(AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.IsActivateCertificate, FALSE) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsActivateCertificate, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.OperationType AS OperationType, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder REFS Document.BonusesPayment THEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Payment ELSE AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Source END AS Source, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Hotel AS Hotel, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Remarks AS Remarks, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Author AS Author, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.ChangeAuthor AS ChangeAuthor, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.ChangeDate AS ChangeDate FROM AccumulationRegister.Bonuses AS AccumulationRegisterBonuses WHERE AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Card = &qCard AND AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Quantity <> 0
GROUP BY AccumulationRegisterBonuses.PointInTime, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Period, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder REFS Document.BonusesPayment THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder REFS Document.BonusesPayment AND ISNULL(AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.IsActivateCertificate, FALSE) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.OperationType, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder REFS Document.BonusesPayment THEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Payment ELSE AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Source END, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Hotel, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.GuestGroup, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Remarks, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Author, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.ChangeAuthor, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.ChangeDate, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.RecordType = VALUE(ВидДвиженияНакопления.Приход) THEN 22 ELSE 23 END

SELECT InformationRegisterDiscounts.Period AS Period, InformationRegisterDiscounts.DiscountType AS DiscountType, InformationRegisterDiscounts.ServiceGroup AS ServiceGroup, InformationRegisterDiscounts.Hotel AS Hotel, InformationRegisterDiscounts.Discount AS Discount FROM InformationRegister.Discounts AS InformationRegisterDiscounts WHERE InformationRegisterDiscounts.DiscountType = &qDiscountType

SELECT InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.Period AS Period, InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.DiscountType AS DiscountType, InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.ResourceLimit AS ResourceLimit, InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.ServiceGroup AS ServiceGroup, InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.Discount AS Discount FROM InformationRegister.AccumulatingDiscounts AS InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts WHERE InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.DiscountType = &qDiscountType
